records.specificationExcerpt:
EVGA X570 FTW WIFI (121-VR-A577)




Motherboard Specifications
        Size:
         ATX form-factor of 12 inches x 9.6 inches (305mm x 243.8mm)
        Microprocessor support:
         AMD AM4 Socket 1331 Processors (Ryzen™ 5000/5000G/4000G/3000
         Series)
        Operating Systems:
         Supports Windows 10 64bit, Windows 11 Ready
        System Memory support:
         Supports up to 128GB Dual channel DDR4 at up to 4600MHz+ (OC).
        USB 2.0 Ports:
         4x internal from 2 FP headers via AMD® X570 PCH
         1x from Update Port for flashing the BIOS without CPU
         Supports hot plug/wake-up from S3 mode
        USB 3.2 Gen.1 Ports:
         6x – 4x external (Type-A) from CPU, 2x internal via 1 FP header from
         AMD® X570 PCH
         Supports transfer speeds up to 5Gb/s
         Backwards-compatible USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 support
        USB 3.2 Gen.2 Ports:
         2x from AMD® X570 PCH – 2x external (Type-A), 1x internal header
         Supports transfer speeds up to 10Gb/s
         Backwards-compatible USB 3.2 Gen.1, USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 support
        Display Outputs:
         Display Port 1.4 / HDMI 2.0
        SATA Ports:
         8x SATA 6Gb/s data transfer rate / AMD X570 PCH
           - Support for RAID0, RAID1, and RAID10 and hot plug
        Onboard LAN:
         Intel® 211AT Gigabit NIC | Intel® Dual-Band Wi-Fi / BT
        Onboard Audio:
         Realtek ALC1220 HD Audio 7.1 Channel/Optical Out + EVGA NU Audio



                                                                                -6-

EVGA X570 FTW WIFI (121-VR-A577)




         Power Functions:
          Supports ACPI (Advanced Configuration and Power Interface)
          Supports S0 (normal), S3 (suspend to RAM), S4 (Suspend to disk - depends
          on OS), and S5 (soft - off)
         PCI-Express Expansion Slots:
            2x PCIe Gen4* x16 slots (via CPU)
            1x PCIe Gen4 x4 slot (via X570 chipset)
         PCIe 4.0* Support:
          Low power consumption and power management features
         SLI and Crossfire Support:
          NVIDIA® SLI® Ready, AMD Multi-GPU Support for DX12
         Additional Expansion Slots:
          1x M.2 Key-M 110mm Gen4 slot (via CPU)**
          1x M.2 Key-M 110mm Gen4 slot (via Chipset)
          1x M.2 Key-E 32mm slot
         Single PS/2 port for keyboard and mouse
         Pump Header:

           1x Pump Header (3A)
         Fan Headers:
           2x 4-pin PWM controlled headers / 5x 4-pin PWM/DC controlled headers

           ALL FAN HEADERS HAVE A MAXIMUM POWER LIMIT
           OF 2 AMP @ 12 VOLTS (24 WATTS). EXCEEDING THIS
           LIMIT WILL CAUSE IRREPARABLE DAMAGE TO THE
           BOARD.




*PCIe® 4.0 requires an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 or 3000 Series processor.
**This M.2 Key-M slot will only function at Gen4 speeds when used with a compatible
AMD Ryzen™ 5000 or 3000 Series processor.

records.slotExcerpt:
EVGA X570 FTW WIFI (121-VR-A577)




PCIe Slot Breakdown
       PCIe Lane Distribution
        PE1 – x16 (Gen4, x16 lanes from CPU, x8 shared with PE2)*
        PE2 – x8 (Gen4, x8 lanes from CPU)
        PE3 – x4 (Gen4, x4 lanes from X570 PCH)



M.2 Slot Breakdown
       M.2 Lane Distribution**
        M.2 Key-M (110mm, Top, M2_1) – Gen4 x4 from CPU*
         o This slot supports PCIe/SATA M.2 SSDs
        M.2 Key-M (110mm, Middle, M2_2) – x4 from X570 PCH
         o This slot supports PCIe/SATA M.2 SSDs
        M.2 Key-E (32mm) – x1 from X570 PCH
         o This slot is pre-installed with the EVGA Wi-Fi/BT Module

*PCIe Gen speed is determined by the installed CPU.
**M.2 Enable/Disable can be configured within the BIOS
